AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM session_resources owner WHERE owner.file_uuid = files.uuid AND owner.workspace_uuid = files.workspace_uuid AND owner.payload IS NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM session_resources owner WHERE owner.file_uuid = files.uuid AND owner.workspace_uuid = files.workspace_uuid AND owner.payload IS NULL AND owner.deleted_at IS NULL AND (owner.expires_at IS NULL OR owner.expires_at > now()) AND left(owner.path, char_length('/outputs/')) = '/outputs/' ) )

catalog_resource AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource.file_uuid) resource.file_uuid, resource.workspace_uuid, resource.session_external_id, resource.created_at, resource.uuid FROM session_resources resource WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND resource.session_external_id = #{params.ScopeID} AND resource.resource_type = 'file' AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL AND (resource.expires_at IS NULL OR resource.expires_at > now()) AND ( (resource.payload IS NOT NULL AND left(resource.path, char_length('/uploads/')) = '/uploads/') OR (resource.payload IS NULL AND left(resource.path, char_length('/outputs/')) = '/outputs/') ) ORDER BY resource.file_uuid, resource.created_at DESC, resource.uuid DESC )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, filename, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, downloadable, scope_type, scope_id, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.FileUUID}, #{params.FileExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Filename}, #{params.MimeType}, #{params.SizeBytes}, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, #{params.Downloadable}, #{params.ScopeType}, #{params.ScopeID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.CreatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT f.uuid, f.external_id, f.workspace_uuid, f.filename, f.mime_type, f.size_bytes, f.sha256, f.s3_bucket, f.s3_key, f.downloadable, f.scope_type, f.scope_id, f.created_by_api_key_uuid, f.created_at FROM files f JOIN workspaces w ON w.uuid = f.workspace_uuid WHERE w.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND f.uuid = #{fileUUID} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

WITH SELECT file.uuid, file.external_id, file.workspace_uuid, file.filename, file.mime_type, file.size_bytes, file.sha256, file.s3_bucket, file.s3_key, file.downloadable, CAST('session' AS text) AS scope_type, resource.session_external_id AS scope_id, file.created_by_api_key_uuid, file.created_at AS created_at FROM catalog_resource resource JOIN files file ON file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid AND file.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY resource.created_at DESC, resource.uuid DESC

WITH SELECT resource.uuid, resource.created_at FROM catalog_resource resource JOIN files file ON file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid AND file.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE file.external_id = #{params.CursorExternalID}

WITH SELECT file.uuid, file.external_id, file.workspace_uuid, file.filename, file.mime_type, file.size_bytes, file.sha256, file.s3_bucket, file.s3_key, file.downloadable, CAST('session' AS text) AS scope_type, resource.session_external_id AS scope_id, file.created_by_api_key_uuid, file.created_at AS created_at FROM catalog_resource resource JOIN files file ON file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid AND file.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE
resource.created_at > #{params.CursorCreatedAt} OR (resource.created_at = #{params.CursorCreatedAt} AND resource.uuid > #{params.CursorUUID})
resource.created_at < #{params.CursorCreatedAt} OR (resource.created_at = #{params.CursorCreatedAt} AND resource.uuid < #{params.CursorUUID})
ORDER BY resource.created_at ASC, resource.uuid ASC
ORDER BY resource.created_at DESC, resource.uuid DESC
LIMIT #{params.Limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, filename, mime_type, detected_mime_type, size_bytes, metadata, authorization_metadata, tags, downloadable, sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at ) SELECT #{params.FileUUID}, #{params.FileExternalID}, session.workspace_uuid, #{params.Filename}, 'application/zip', 'application/zip', #{params.SizeBytes}, jsonb_build_object('skill_source', CAST(#{params.Source} AS text)), CAST('{}' AS jsonb), CAST(ARRAY[] AS text[]), false, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, session.created_by_api_key_uuid, #{params.Now} FROM sessions session WHERE session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND session.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND session.deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO jobs (external_id, workspace_uuid, type, status, payload) VALUES ( concat('job_', replace(CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS text), '-', '')), #{workspaceUUID}, 'object_cleanup', 'pending', CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: WITH next_jobs AS ( SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE type = 'object_cleanup' AND run_after <= now() AND ( status IN ('pending', 'retry') OR (status = 'running' AND locked_until < now()) ) ORDER BY run_after, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{workerID}, locked_until = now() + interval '1 minute', updated_at = now() FROM next_jobs WHERE j.uuid = next_jobs.uuid RETURNING j.uuid, j.external_id, j.workspace_uuid, COALESCE(j.payload->>'bucket', '') AS bucket, COALESCE(j.payload->>'key', '') AS object_key, COALESCE(j.payload->>'file_id', '') AS file_external_id, j.attempts
UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'

UPDATE jobs SET status = #{params.Status}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, run_after = #{params.RunAfter}, updated_at = now(), attempts = #{params.Attempts}, payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('last_error', CAST(#{params.Reason} AS text)) WHERE uuid = #{params.JobUUID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'
